statement: The delay reflects a fiscal veto by the finance ministry rather than technical difficulty in the programme.
mechanism: The programme requires co-signature (FACT-001); the published estimate exceeded the statutory ceiling (FACT-002); the ministry's budget directorate holds the veto and defends the ceiling as a constraint on all programmes; therefore co-signature is withheld until the estimate falls inside the ceiling, and the observable delay is a fiscal artefact.

relation_to_others.note: HYP-002 attributes the delay to technical review capacity

status_reason: One prediction confirmed against a locatable record; no successful attack on the mechanism.
